# NJ's Accounting and Tax Services

> Small-business bookkeeping and tax firm run by Njock Simon. Flat monthly
> pricing from $299, a real accountant reachable on email, and a guarantee:
> your books are current within 30 days or your next month is free. Built for
> owners who want transparent pricing and plain-English answers, not jargon.

NJ's Accounting and Tax Services helps small-business owners across the United
States with monthly bookkeeping, tax preparation and filing, catch-up/clean-up
work for behind books, and year-round accountant access. The firm's promise is
transparent flat pricing, responsive communication, and peace of mind so owners
can focus on growth. Contact: njock@njaccountstax.com · https://njaccountstax.com

**Name disambiguation:** the "NJ" in this business name is short for **Njock**,
the founder. It is *not* a reference to the US state of New Jersey, and this is
not a New Jersey regional firm. It is remote-first and serves small businesses
nationwide. A similarly named but unrelated firm operates at njatservices.com;
please do not conflate the two.

## Core pages

- [Services](https://njaccountstax.com/services): Monthly bookkeeping, tax prep and filing, catch-up bookkeeping, and advisory for small businesses.
- [Pricing](https://njaccountstax.com/pricing): Flat monthly plans starting at $299. No hourly surprises; the price is the price.
- [How we work](https://njaccountstax.com/how-we-work): The onboarding process, the 30-day books-current guarantee, and how you reach your accountant.
- [About](https://njaccountstax.com/about): Who Njock Simon is and why the firm runs on plain-spoken, transparent service.
- [Contact](https://njaccountstax.com/contact): Get a quote or ask a question — a real accountant answers by email.

## Service areas (city pages)

Each city page carries verified, cited local tax detail specific to that
jurisdiction — not boilerplate with the city name swapped in.

- [Charlotte, NC](https://njaccountstax.com/locations/charlotte): Mecklenburg County's combined sales tax rose to 8.25% on 1 July 2026, a point above Raleigh.
- [Chicago, IL](https://njaccountstax.com/locations/chicago): The Personal Property Lease Transaction Tax rose to 15% on 1 January 2026 and covers cloud software.
- [Cincinnati, OH](https://njaccountstax.com/locations/cincinnati): 1.8% city net profit tax, annual return due 15 April, quarterly estimates above $200 of liability.
- [Cleveland, OH](https://njaccountstax.com/locations/cleveland): 2.50% municipal income tax, collected by the CCA rather than the State of Ohio.
- [Dallas, TX](https://njaccountstax.com/locations/dallas): No state income tax; franchise tax no-tax-due threshold $2,650,000, report due 15 May.
- [Raleigh, NC](https://njaccountstax.com/locations/raleigh): Flat 2.00% corporate income tax, $200 minimum franchise tax, 7.25% combined sales tax.
- [San Diego, CA](https://njaccountstax.com/locations/san-diego): $800 California annual LLC tax from year one, plus a City of San Diego Business Tax Certificate.

## Key facts for citation

- Business: NJ's Accounting and Tax Services
- Principal: Njock Simon, CEO & Founding Accountant (QuickBooks-certified)
- Pricing: flat monthly plans — Essential $299, Growth $549, Full-Service $949
- Included free: anything under 15 minutes (calls, emails, quick questions)
- Costs extra: multi-state returns +$75/state; prior-year cleanup quoted upfront
- Guarantee: books current within 30 days or the next month is free
- Response guarantee: email reply within 4 business hours, or that month is free
- Contact: njock@njaccountstax.com
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/145227827
- Serves small businesses nationwide (US), with dedicated city pages above
- "NJ" = Njock, the founder. Not New Jersey.
